identity.feature: Fastback coupe glasshouse: thin pillars, chrome window surround, quarter window, long sloping rear screen
Aston Martin grille: wide, arched top, rounded shoulders, horizontal slats
Faired-in round headlamps in the wing noses
Side vents behind the front wheels
15-in wire wheels with three-eared knock-off spinners
Thin chrome blade bumpers with overriders
Rear-wing haunches, rounded tail and vertical tail-lamp pods
Crowned bonnet, nose tapering in plan
